en: This is a vintage black-and-white postcard. The front depicts a stately villa with elaborate gabled roofs (Villa Muhle) in a lush, tree-lined park featuring a large central fountain. A person strolls along the path. At the bottom, there is printed text: 'Pyrmont. Untere Hauptallee mit Villa Muhle.' The reverse has handwritten German text, addresses, a 5 Pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp postmarked 'Pyrmont,' and institutional museum labeling.
